seoTitle: Video Contact Sheet Maker: Overview Grid of Frames
metaDescription: Make one image with evenly spaced frames and timestamps from a video. Choose rows, columns and size. Private, browser only.
intro: Samples frames at even intervals and arranges them in a grid image with timestamps, for a quick overview of a video.
why:
A contact sheet lets you scan a long recording at a glance, review a screen capture or send a preview. The frames are taken from the middle of equal segments, so the first and last seconds are not over represented.

The sheet is a PNG you download. No upload happens.
howTo: Set the number of columns, rows and the thumbnail width.
Press Process and download the PNG.

faq.q: How many frames can I include?

faq.a: Use the Video Frame Grabber for chosen times.
It may be a frame between keyframes during motion.
Width times columns, so keep thumbnails modest for sharing.
